correctness.rationale: For N>=1, d>=N+1, L,D>0 and positive deterministic per-step variance ceilings, reconstruct the sharp short-step bound Phi=LD²/(2T0)+sum v_i h_i²/(2L T_{i+1}), T_i=1+2 sum_{j>=i}h_j. Published nonnegative smooth-convex interpolation certificate weights each conditional noise term separately. The separable coordinate Huber construction with fresh independent symmetric errors attains every summand for every sign history. Quadratic-perspective strict convexity and coercivity prove unique nonnegative optimizer; interior first-order equations give v_{i+1}c_{i+1}=v_i c_i(1+c_i), c_i=h_i/T_{i+1}, and monotonic scalar root. Algebra gives h_i>=h_{i+1} iff v_{i+1}/v_i>=1-c_i-2c_i². Rational case c=(1/10,11/25), v=(78125/39762,78125/159048) yields h=(47/250,11/25) and strictly reversed ordering. GLOBAL minimax equality requires the computed optimum lie within the 0..3/2 short-step certificate; no claim beyond that domain. Finite tests supplement, not replace, the published nonstandard interpolation inequality and analytic construction.
